C1550.title: Multichain Cross-Chain Bridge Founders Detained by Chinese Police
C1550.summary: The CEO and other founders of the Chinese-led cross-chain bridge project Multichain were taken into custody by Chinese police over alleged criminal offenses, triggering an overnight collapse in the token price. The incident exposed significant compliance and fund custody risks in cross-chain bridges, leaving user assets frozen or inaccessible.
